module: Computes anchor points on the bottom of an object's bounding box for the Easy Select tool. Three patterns are produced: shortEdge (middle of the short side, at z min), longEdge (middle of the long side) and shortEdgeOrigin (like shortEdge but at local z = 0, at the origin level). The "long" axis is X if the scaled extent in X >= that in Y. Used to describe reference edges for moving/snapping.

describeBox.desc: Describes a local box (methods getCenter/getExtents and minExtents/maxExtents). Returns nil if the box is not valid.

returns.desc: {isLongX, scaledX, scaledY, shortEdge, longEdge, shortEdgeOrigin}, each edge having firstLocal/secondLocal

describeMeshBox.desc: Same as describeBox for a simple mesh box {minExtents, maxExtents, center, extents}. nil if a field is missing.

describeObject.desc: Describes a scene object in world coordinates. Uses getObjBox + getTransform + getScale if possible; otherwise falls back to the world box getWorldBox. Each pattern contains first, second, firstOffset, secondOffset, centerOffset (offsets relative to the object's position).

returns.desc: {isLongX, scaledX, scaledY, shortEdge, longEdge, shortEdgeOrigin} or nil if no valid box
